data.why: the repo bundles two real hemispherical fisheye photos used as the README's own worked examples, which the browser can upload through the file_uploader

goals: Upload a fisheye canopy photo and compute leaf area index (LAI) and gap fraction
Adjust the circular mask (xc, yc, rc) so the fisheye field of view is correctly isolated
Compare Otsu vs zonal vs manual binarization thresholds to separate sky from canopy
Derive clumping index (LX, LXG1, LXG2) and mean leaf tilt angle from gap fraction rings/sectors
Check how lens model (equidistant vs FC-E8) and VZA range change the computed LAI

review.summary: The tree follows the README's Import → Binarize → Gap Fraction → Canopy Attributes pipeline, and adds a sensible sensitivity phase whose numbers mostly match the screens. Before filing it needs a channel/pre-processing step and feature, a replacement for the mid-rerun zonal screen (043), and labels on the P042b and VZA runs saying they used non-default settings carried over from earlier runs.
